manifest.encoding: UTF-8 without BOM; one unique key=value per line; at most 16384 bytes
manifest.hashes: lowercase SHA256 of host executable, supplied runtime and repository/engine/host-policy.el

selection: DDSKK_HOST_BUNDLE_MANIFEST; absent preserves S1-S4; incompatible disables every managed switch before child launch and logs native fallback

private_controls.PRIVATE OWNER 1: OWNER <host PID>; verify the public endpoint belongs to the process just spawned
private_controls.guard: manifest environment present, Software\NativeIME-test- registry branch, non-live pipe
private_controls.barrier: freeze engine transactions; native fence outside interpreter gate; unchanged fence before shutdown; process exit/drain before the next owner
private_controls.sessions: never transferred across hosts; clients reconnect, OPEN 2 and re-establish prepared state; never blindly retry editing

deployment_journal.publication: fsync temporary file, then MoveFileExW REPLACE_EXISTING|WRITE_THROUGH
deployment_journal.exclusive_lease: Windows file handle with no sharing; OS releases on coordinator crash
deployment_journal.prepared: old authoritative; composition/storage deferral keeps old
deployment_journal.released: old authoritative; canceled warmup/crash recovers old from durable journals
deployment_journal.committed: new authoritative; rollback commits inverse selection
deployment_journal.retention: never delete old bundles, user dictionary, provider cursors, client spools or generation files in this script

execution: foreground scoped deployment; own suspended hosts in kill-on-close job; no registry/registration writes, live paths or live wrapper calls; one IME stack at a time
limits: sequential private prewarm follows old drain to respect one-stack machine-load constraint; disconnected interval is explicit, not seamless host session transfer
